items.title: Vercel Connect now supports Secure Compute
items.summary: now supports , allowing connectors to reach providers with IP allowlists, such as Salesforce and Snowflake.Vercel ConnectSecure ComputeWith Secure Compute routing enabled, Connect’s provider requests use the selected network’s dedicated static IP addresses instead of Connect’s shared IPs. Requests to obtain and refresh access tokens follow that route; your app’s direct API routing is unchanged by this setting. Credential management stays the same, so you don’t need to store long-lived provider secrets in your app or build OAuth flows yourself.To enable Secure Compute routing for a supported connector and all projects that use it:Requests for initial connector creation and all provider discovery requests bypass the selected network and connect directly to providers. If the selected network is unavailable, routed requests fail instead of falling back to Connect’s shared IPs.Read the  for configuration details.Secure Compute routing documentationRead moreOpen your connector’s  in the Vercel dashboard.SettingsUnder , choose an existing network.Secure Compute RoutingIf your provider uses an IP allowlist, add the selected network’s displayed IP addresses to it in the provider’s settings.Save your changes in Connect.
